golden_baseline_location: etl/legacy-extra/crontab plus the deterministic legacy run_all output for the unit's own namespace (ingest 2 files, parse 50+50 records with trailer 50 each, finance report written) — the end-state outputs the chain must reproduce

acceptance_checks.description: Task dependencies are declared (parse depends on ingest completing, finance depends on parse), replacing the crontab's :05 offset and run_all.sh's sleep 600 — no time-based coupling anywhere.
The job sets max_concurrent_runs=1 so an overlapping trigger queues instead of racing (the legacy 02:10 finance / 02:00 analytics overlap cannot recur).
A failing upstream task blocks its downstream tasks and the run reports failure — the chain never ends in 'done (probably)' after a failed stage.
Tasks declare bounded retries, and the job has a failure notification path; a failed run is observable without reading /var/log/etl.
One chain run over a freshly seeded namespace reproduces the same end-state as the deterministic legacy run_all: same landed files, same silver row count, same six-row gold aggregate to the cent.
Re-running the chain over the same input leaves all target row counts and the export byte-identical.
Any schedule the job carries is created PAUSED; the demo triggers it by Run Now (no unattended compute).

planted_anomalies.description: Concurrent triggers must serialize (max_concurrent_runs=1) instead of a later stage reading a half-produced artifact.
A stage that fails must fail the run; the converted chain must not report overall success with a failed stage.

planted_anomalies.reason: Record-level anomaly detection belongs to dbx-parse; the orchestration unit asserts stage sequencing and end-state parity, not record validation.

encoding_policy.input_encoding: inherited from the tasks it orchestrates (byte-transparent ingest, lossless-fallback parse)
encoding_policy.byte_transparency: the orchestration layer must not rewrite, re-encode, or normalize any artifact passed between tasks
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: handled by the owning task; the chain neither inspects nor repairs record content

malformed_record_policy.details: Run parameters (namespace, source period, target paths) are mandatory: a missing or empty parameter fails the run rather than defaulting to a namespace or path that could touch another slice.

empty_input_semantics.details: A chain run with no new input succeeds having done nothing and leaves all prior outputs intact — the 'just rerun everything' path must be safe.
